body:
Create Bind destinations and the query together for one call. In Each callbacks copy the populated values before retaining them. For shared query shapes, compose Field with Map/Map2 into a Reader and use fresh per-row storage in custom allocators. The reason is lifetime ownership: a saved pointer to a reused binding observes later rows.
